description: Iberia Club Avios and Elite Points for an Iberia (IB) ticket. Avios = fare in EUR (fare plus carrier charges, no taxes, whole ticket) x tier factor (Clasica 5, Plata 6, Oro 7, Platino 8, Platino Prime 9; one more per euro when every flight is on the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle, two more to or from Latin America). Elite Points = 1 per euro plus Extra Elite Points per flight by cabin, fare (Basic none; Optimal, Comfort, Flexible) and distance (up to or over 3,000 miles), with progress toward Plata, Oro, Platino and Platino Prime (ep and fl: Elite Points and flights so far). Give segs: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them), the ISO country codes of its two airports, and from/to IATA airport codes: Iberia needs them to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD-BCN), which earns its own Avios and Extra Elite Points; without them that flight counts as an ordinary short flight. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Give the price in EUR, not US dollars. Unofficial.

cabin.description: Cabin. Y = Economy; W = Premium Economy (long haul); C = Business.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of Iberia's own: alaska = Atmos Rewards (creditStatus one of: Atmos Rewards member, Atmos Silver, Atmos Gold, Atmos Platinum, Atmos Titanium). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. Give the booking class letter as creditClass. The flights are segs (their miles), or creditFlights. No price is needed with creditTo.

ep.description: Elite Points you have since 1 April (optional). Used only for the progress toward the next tier.

fare.description: Fare. B = Basic; O = Optimal; C = Comfort; F = Flexible. The fare brand on your booking. Basic earns no Extra Elite Points and is Economy only. On the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle choose Comfort or Flexible. Executive is left out: Iberia's Extra Elite Points table does not list it (choose Basic to see the spend alone).

fl.description: Qualifying flights you have since 1 April (optional). Plata, Oro and Platino can also be reached with 20, 40 or 90 flights.

price.description: Ticket fare in euros (whole trip) in EUR. The fare and carrier charges, without taxes and fees, for the whole ticket. Enter it in euros; Iberia converts a fare in another currency at the IATA rate on the day the ticket is issued. Required unless creditTo is given.

segs.description: The flights, one way and in order, one entry per flight (1 to 8): fromCountry and toCountry, the ISO 3166 two-letter country codes of its two airports; miles, its great-circle distance in miles (1 to 12,500); optional cabin (Y, W, C) for a flight in another cabin than the ticket's; optional from and to, the IATA codes of its two airports, which label the breakdown; some airlines also use them (Vladivostok, VVO, on JAL and ANA; the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle, MAD-BCN, on Iberia; the long-haul tables named by city on SAS).

cabin.description: This flight's cabin, when it differs from the ticket's cabin.

from.description: The departure airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

fromCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the departure airport, e.g. DE.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

toCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the arrival airport, e.g. DE.

tier.description: Your Iberia Club tier. CL = Clásica (5 per euro); PL = Plata (6 per euro); OR = Oro (7 per euro); PT = Platino (8 per euro); PP = Platino Prime (9 per euro). Sets the Avios per euro. Infinita and Infinita Prime are not offered: Iberia does not publish their Avios rate.

trip.description: Trip. ow = One way; rt = Round trip. Round trip counts the same flights back the other way for Extra Elite Points. The fare above is for the whole ticket either way.
